name: Pathrus
overview: Pathrus is a male figure mentioned in the Bible as the son of Mizraim. Beyond this unique attribute, the Scripture does not provide additional tribal affiliation or personal notes about him. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical in nature.
namesAndTitles: The name Pathrus appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:14. No specific meaning or divine origin of the name is provided in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Pathrus as a son of Mizraim, establishing his place within the genealogical line descending from Noah's descendants. No further family relationships are detailed beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Pathrus holds significance as part of the genealogical record tracing the descendants of Mizraim, who is traditionally associated with Egypt. This lineage helps to map the early peoples and nations following the flood, showing the expansion of humanity as ordained by God. While Pathrus himself is not elaborated upon, his mention situates him within God's providential plan for the nations.
